scope: Public GCU experience. Candidate frontend served over the production origin with actual production GET data, Matterport scene and SDK. No vendor verification bypass or mocked SDK readiness.

fixes.before: The empty From flow hid the Pick on map prompt and exposed no map-picking autocomplete action.
fixes.after: From includes the localized Choose on Map action, alongside POI search; To search and endpoint swapping retain their existing behavior.

fixes.before: On mobile the directions sheet intercepted picker Cancel taps; cancellation could leave the directions prompt hidden. The Not right action called an unavailable map adapter.
fixes.after: Opening the picker closes overlapping sheets; Cancel restores the current directions state, stale attempts cannot restore old UI, and Not right reopens Matterport picking.

fixes.before: A picked point lost its vertical coordinate; routing reconstructed it from configured floor elevation and could use another level. Shared location links also lost height.
fixes.after: The finite picked height is stored before localization callbacks, used for the route origin, and preserved in the optional fourth me-link field. Existing three-field links remain supported.

fixes.before: A stalled bootstrap or SDK handshake could leave the startup promise pending after the loader reported failure.
fixes.after: SDK bootstrap and handshake attempts have 30-second and 60-second deadlines; failed loads can retry and late timed-out SDK connections are released without replacing the active connection.

fixes.before: Lifecycle diagnostics probed a cross-origin Matterport document and could fail while cleaning the previous document in WebKit.
fixes.after: Diagnostics avoid known cross-origin document reads and tolerate revoked access during cleanup. Candidate core interactions recorded zero page errors.

fixes.before: Every visit requested the absent optional /ar_webxr/launch.js module and returned 404.
fixes.after: The unused eager import is removed. Existing published external place/route AR handoffs remain working.

mobile_browser.note: The retained Home/marker check attempted a hidden marker in directions state. Home and zoom were retested successfully in the desktop follow-up; marker click was not established by this candidate run.

all_destination_routing.note: Actual public coordinates and navmesh. One origin to each published destination, not all possible pairs.

features_passed: Search, empty results, clear and real camera focus
French, Arabic RTL and English restoration
From and To editing, swap, units and route share
Public map-picker Cancel, reopen and genuine confirmation
Manual Walkthrough, Next, Previous and Exit
Desktop zoom and actual Home/return camera modes
External place and route AR URL handoffs

remaining_limits: A physical iPhone is required to establish Safari/Chrome memory-pressure and reload behavior.
External AR URL handoff was tested; real camera/location-based AR was not.
No authenticated admin edits, feedback submissions or other production data writes were tested.
Known Matterport analytics blocking, verification pages and vendor/unknown errors during deliberate navigation remain recorded; they are not suppressed or claimed fixed.
Marker selection was pending a focused fresh-page check at the time of this pre-deploy report.
Legacy deployments that separately provide the removed optional WebXR launcher must load that module explicitly.
report_stage: pre-deploy candidate acceptance; deployment verification is recorded separately
